text.tspan: How to test the value of the agentic framework
Proposed evaluation: separate component accuracy from the beneﬁt of adaptive coordination.
adaptive decisions versus a ﬁxed workﬂow
One agent with all tools versus specialized
agents with the same total resource budget
handoﬀ errors and ﬁnal candidate quality
Initial ranking versus an updated ranking
independent reactions, ﬁxed data access, repeated runs, matched cost, and separate development/test sets.
A traceable explanation supports auditability; improved scientiﬁc performance needs a controlled comparison.
Evaluation design, not completed comparative results. Unjudged candidates remain separate from conﬁrmed negatives.
